verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows HMRC publishing an llms.txt file or documentation written for AI agents. The only relevant item is the probe of the developer hub's robots.txt, which disallows every crawler except Googlebot; that points away from agent-friendly docs. The 'agent' sign-up path in the guidance refers to human tax agents, not AI agents, so it does not count here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
